web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: The latest Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) for China's manufacturing sector stood at 49.2% in July, indicating a contraction. This follows months of targeted fiscal and monetary support by Chinese officials, suggesting structural headwinds still face the economy. The National Bureau of Statistics reported a 5.3% year-on-year increase in value-added industrial output, with high-tech manufacturing rising by 13.8%.
